# Harshal Dasani

> Business Head at INVasset PMS & AIF, Mumbai. Markets professional and writer. CFA candidate, CA Level II cleared. Featured in 1,500+ media features across 200+ publications in 12 languages. Topics: Indian equity markets, commodities, macros, geopolitics.

## Primary pages

- [About, Harshal Dasani](https://harshaldasani.pages.dev/): personal page with bio, stats and links to social channels.
- [Media Features Tracker](https://harshaldasani.pages.dev/tracker/): live searchable database of every article, interview and quote across 200+ publications.
- [Markets with Harshal - Blog](https://harshaldasani.pages.dev/blog/): long-form notes on stock markets, commodities, macros and geopolitics.
- [Tools](https://harshaldasani.pages.dev/tools/): free calculators - SIP, returns / CAGR / XIRR, capital-gains tax, and an oil-to-India impact estimator.
